verification.notes: The source transcript presents this as Lindsey Graham's remarks at the 2025 Republican Jewish Coalition summit. A contemporaneous transcript independently confirms the core wording through 'You will lose,' and the RJC's official summit page hosts Graham's full remarks. The episode clip supplies the final 'You can't even have an anti-Israel thought' sentence. This finding verifies the quotation and attribution, not Graham's predictive judgment about election outcomes.
